identity_boundary: Relational working language only; no continuity or authority claim.

observed_failures.observed: The first inherited manifest verifier incorrectly limited the tree to documentation paths and reported 4, 23, and 28 false mismatches for scripts and tests.
observed_failures.recovery: Replay each declared path against its exact Git blob across the full tree with cat-file batch checks.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never narrow a commit-local manifest to an assumed subtree when the manifest declares repository-relative paths.

observed_failures.observed: A full-tree manifest wrapper completed without an attributable result, so it earned no verification credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Use bounded cat-file batch-check witnesses and retain per-manifest counts and mismatches.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Poll every yielded native-command session and preserve all output chunks.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only skill lookup guessed references/schema.md for Auth Permission State, which does not exist.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate the exact skill directory and read auth-permission-state-schema.md.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never infer reference filenames when an exact skill tree is available.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only skill lookup guessed references/schema.md for Roster Check, which does not exist.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate the exact skill directory and read roster-state-schema.md.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never infer reference filenames when an exact skill tree is available.

observed_failures.observed: The first whole-file activation read exceeded the useful output window and could not prove EOF.
observed_failures.recovery: Read the immutable baton in bounded ordered chunks through its final line.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Count lines first and use bounded ranges for long activation packets.

observed_failures.observed: A combined multi-file guidance read exceeded the useful output window and earned no complete-read credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Read each required state and reference independently through EOF.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep exact-head and installed-skill reads attributable to one bounded file at a time.

observed_failures.observed: A raw semantic-novelty audit read exceeded useful context during startup compaction.
observed_failures.recovery: Parse exact keys and rows through bounded scalar and selected-record probes.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect large JSON by schema and bounded selections rather than raw rendering.

observed_failures.observed: Five parallel JSON probes yielded inner sessions whose early outputs were not preserved, so their blank wrapper result earned zero credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Poll every returned inner session and concatenate all chunks before attribution.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Treat session identifiers as incomplete results, never as completed commands.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only lookup guessed x1/proposal-ledger.json, but the exact path is preregistration/proposal-ledger.json.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate exact proposal paths with rg --files before parsing.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never infer lifecycle subdirectories from historical layouts.

observed_failures.observed: A combined PowerShell preflight placed native commands and exit-code checks inside expressions and failed before execution.
observed_failures.recovery: Run each native command first, capture LASTEXITCODE into a scalar, then compose the receipt.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never embed semicolon-separated native commands inside PowerShell parenthesized expressions or hash values.

observed_failures.observed: A yielded preflight wrapper preserved only its final chunk and lost earlier scalar outputs, so it earned no complete receipt credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Accumulate initial and subsequent session output before parsing.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Always concatenate every exec and poll chunk for long native-command probes.

observed_failures.observed: The first post-worktree audit repeated the native-command-in-expression PowerShell parser fault before execution.
observed_failures.recovery: Scalarize merge-base status before composing the audit object.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Apply the scalar native-command guard to every history and equality receipt.

observed_failures.observed: A full workflow-refinement JSON rendering exceeded the useful output window and received no complete-read credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Use exact schema keys, counts, policy-check selections, and bounded sections.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect large lifecycle JSON by declared schema and bounded keys.

observed_failures.observed: The first direct NIST publication page open returned an internal retrieval error.
observed_failures.recovery: Use the stable CSRC final-publication URL already cited by the exact source ledger and make no claim from the failed retrieval.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Retain failed source retrievals and rely only on independently resolved official pages.

observed_failures.observed: The first complete 2,620-row novelty computation reached output but the CP1252 console could not encode Māori text, so the attempt earned zero audit credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Rerun the same read-only computation with PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 and retain the failed output witness.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Set explicit UTF-8 for Unicode-bearing Python diagnostics before execution.

observed_failures.observed: A mechanical test-template migration replaced both the inherited and effective novelty counts with 2,650 before any test or staging.
observed_failures.recovery: Correct the assertions explicitly to 2,620 inherited and 2,650 effective and retain the failed edit assumption.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never chain overlapping numeric replacements; patch semantic fields by name and review the diff immediately.

observed_failures.observed: The first x1 build bound the activation baton to checkout bytes while the inherited guard correctly required exact committed Git-blob bytes, then failed before packet generation.
observed_failures.recovery: Compute and record the exact Git-blob and checkout SHA-256 domains separately before rerunning.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Every provenance digest must name and validate its byte domain explicitly.

observed_failures.observed: The first generated workflow plan used a truthful custom no-successor phrase where the installed validator requires its canonical existing-task-after-terminal-gate token, so the plan was rejected.
observed_failures.recovery: Use the validator's exact boundary token while preserving the explicit no-successor authorization in the route-state artifact.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Separate schema vocabulary from phase-specific route state and validate both before credit.

observed_failures.observed: The first stale-domain scan searched the immutable 2,620-row inherited proposal chain, found legitimate historical optics titles, and truncated its output before an owner-authored conclusion.
observed_failures.recovery: Exclude frozen inherited title payloads and scan only Tamar-authored fields, builders, ledgers, reports, route state, and validation surfaces.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Scope stale-label review by provenance ownership; never treat inherited evidence vocabulary as a current-owner stale label.

observed_failures.observed: The first staged-status diagnostic treated Git's NUL-delimited name-status stream as one record per token and falsely classified every path token as a non-added status.
observed_failures.recovery: Use line-based name-status records or parse the alternating status and path tokens as pairs.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect native output framing before assigning semantic meaning to NUL-delimited tokens.

observed_failures.observed: The wrapper that staged the review receipt and then combined diff and status probes yielded after the add, returned only the line-ending warning, and temporarily left two read-only Git probes without attributable completion.
observed_failures.recovery: Wait for the exact read-only Git processes to finish, then run one supervised scalar status or diff probe per session.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not append long read-only audits to a staging command on a large worktree; supervise each postcondition independently.
